high_severity_cves.description:
When a post is published, Postiz treats a media path that is not a web address as a file on the server's disk, but it does not check that the file lies inside the upload directory. A registered user can store a crafted media path with a post, get it past the checks that normally restrict it, and have the publishing worker read an arbitrary file and send it as an attachment to a Discord server the user controls.

The same unconfined reads can be reached through two further routes. One tells the caller whether a file exists and can exhaust the backend's memory, the other delivers the file the same way as the main route. Self-registration is open by default, so the attacker needs no existing account.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Knit Pay UPI QR Code Payment Gateway for WooCommerce upi-qr-code-payment-for-woocommerce allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects UPI QR Code Payment Gateway for WooCommerce: from n/a through 1.6.3.
Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Christoph Vielgrader Relevanssi  relevanssi allows Object Injection.This issue affects Relevanssi : from n/a through 4.28.4.

Postiz signs its session, invitation and password reset tokens with one shared secret and without any marker of what a token is for. A route that refreshes the credentials of a browser-extension channel signed data taken from the request itself and stored the result where the requesting user can read it back. A user could therefore obtain a validly signed token containing any claims they choose, which the application accepts as a session, as an organization invitation with a chosen role, as a password reset or as an enterprise provisioning token.

A second, narrower route that creates team invitations signs extra fields from the request body in the same way.

A flaw has been found in Travisun Opptrix 0.4.0. This affects an unknown function of the file /api/auth/setup of the component Schedule API. This manipulation causes command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The project has been completely taken offline and deprecated. The project maintainer explains: "The mentioned security risk was a design flaw that manifested primarily in local environments during earlier stages of version development. We previously addressed and resolved this specific risk; however, because the project was restricted to a small learning scope and the main versions were intended to run exclusively on localhost, the security fix was only pushed directly to our GitHub repository before it went private." This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

A vulnerability has been found in Travisun Opptrix 0.4.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file /api/system-update/import of the component Import Endpoint. Such manipulation leads to code injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The project has been completely taken offline and deprecated. The project maintainer explains: "The mentioned security risk was a design flaw that manifested primarily in local environments during earlier stages of version development. We previously addressed and resolved this specific risk; however, because the project was restricted to a small learning scope and the main versions were intended to run exclusively on localhost, the security fix was only pushed directly to our GitHub repository before it went private." This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE (component: JSSE).  Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u511-b32, 8u511-perf-b32, 11.0.33.0.2, 17.0.21.0.2, 21.0.13.0.2, 25.0.5.0.2, 27.0.1.0.2; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.21.0.2 and  21.0.13.0.2; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.20.0.2. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data or all Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition accessible data as well as  unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition accessible data. Note: This vulnerability can be exploited by using APIs in the specified Component, e.g., through a web service which supplies data to the APIs. This vulnerability also applies to Java deployments, typically in clients running sandboxed Java Web Start applications or sandboxed Java applets, that load and run untrusted code (e.g., code that comes from the internet) and rely on the Java sandbox for security. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 9.1 (Confidentiality and Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N).

A vulnerability was identified in FaveoSuite Faveo Helpdesk 2.0.3. Affected by this issue is the function ForgotPasswordController::sendResetLinkEmail/PasswordController::reset of the file app/Http/Controllers/Auth/ForgotPasswordController.php. The manipulation leads to weak password recovery. The attack may be initiated remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

A security vulnerability has been detected in Unitree Robotics Unitree Go2 up to 1.1.11.4. The impacted element is the function set_volume of the file gpt_thread.py of the component chat_go. Such manipulation of the argument Value leads to os command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. Upgrading to version 1.1.11.5 is sufficient to resolve this issue. You should upgrade the affected component. The vendor confirmed early: "Submission 990502 corresponds to our internal ticket #474 (Go2 chat_go set_volume OS command injection, CWE-78)."

A vulnerability has been found in mansi-k Restaurant_IMS d7ad49f61ab7cc1ec6eb359ac2b5378bdbde0694. Affected is the function mysqli_connect of the file lsmodal.php. The manipulation of the argument login_id/epsw leads to sql injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. This product follows a rolling release approach for continuous delivery, so version details for affected or updated releases are not provided. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A security flaw has been discovered in Zylon PrivateGPT 1.0.0/1.0.1. This vulnerability affects the function load_file_from_uri of the file private_gpt/server/ingest/uri_loader.py of the component URI Artifact Loader. Performing a manipulation of the argument Value results in server-side request forgery. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was detected in YunaiV/zhijiantianya ruoyi-vue-pro up to 2026.09. The affected element is an unknown function of the file AuthController.java of the component SMS Code Verification. The manipulation of the argument mobile/code results in improper authentication. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was detected in krupalshah EmployeeRecruitmentSystem up to 922ff6d208278282e7c8e36d70d9ae356adec9fe. Affected by this vulnerability is the function mysql_query of the file /source/registerform1.php of the component Registration. Performing a manipulation of the argument firstname/middlename/lastname/gender/birthdate/state/statespecify/city/cityspecify results in sql injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. This product is using a rolling release to provide continious delivery. Therefore, no version details for affected nor updated releases are available. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

Paisa before 0.7.8 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the GetFile, GetSheet, DeleteBackups, and DeleteSheetBackups handlers that lets unauthenticated attackers read files and delete backups through ../ sequences in file names. Attackers can send crafted names to the editor file and delete_backups endpoints to read any server-readable file and remove backup files outside the journal or sheets directory.

Dokploy through 0.30.10 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows owners or admins of any organization to control other tenants' applications by supplying foreign applicationId values. Attackers can call procedures like saveEnvironment, updateTraefikConfig, deploy, or stop to overwrite environment variables and build secrets, repoint sources, and disrupt other tenants' applications.

Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

executive_summary: Our environment faces critical exposure across multiple platforms. Seventeen high-severity CVEs have been identified, including two near-perfect CVSS 9.9 and 9.6 scores in Postiz affecting session token security and arbitrary file read. Oracle Java SE carries a CVSS 9.1 vulnerability in JSSE. Additionally, eight new CISA Known Exploited Vulnerability catalog entries were added in the past seven days, covering Arista VeloCloud, Collabora Online, and Plex Media Server — all indicating active exploitation in the wild. Immediate remediation and patching are required to reduce organizational risk.
action_items: Patch or mitigate Postiz CVE-2026-115933 (CVSS 9.9) and CVE-2026-115932 (CVSS 9.6) immediately by rotating shared secrets and restricting media path handling.
Apply Oracle Java SE patches for CVE-2026-114820 (CVSS 9.1) across all affected JDK and GraalVM instances without delay.
Audit and remediate all eight newly added CISA KEV entries, prioritizing Arista VeloCloud and Plex Media Server given confirmed active exploitation.
Address the Unitree Robotics CVE-2026-115995 (CVSS 9.6) by restricting network access to affected robotic systems and applying vendor patches.
Remediate deserialization and missing authorization vulnerabilities in WordPress plugins (CVE-2026-114704, CVE-2026-114191) to prevent object injection and privilege escalation.
risk_narrative: The current threat landscape combines critical unpatched vulnerabilities with confirmed active exploitation. CISA KEV additions signal that threat actors are actively leveraging weaknesses in widely deployed products including media servers and network orchestration platforms. The Postiz token confusion flaw enables privilege escalation and account takeover at scale. Oracle Java SE exposure broadens attack surface across enterprise environments. Deserialization flaws and missing authorization controls in popular WordPress plugins increase the risk of supply-chain-style compromise. Collectively, these vulnerabilities expose the organization to data breaches, service disruption, unauthorized access, and potential regulatory liability.
